timeline.what: Payments v2.31 deployed. The release cuts the database connection pool from 50 to 20.
First support ticket: the checkout spinner does not finish.
Alert fires: payments p95 above 2 s for 2 minutes. Page sent to on-call.
Payments logs show requests waiting for a database connection.
Incident declared (SEV-2). Aiko takes incident commander.
Mei joins and points at the pool size change in v2.31.
Payments p95 peaks at 3.7 s. Client retries push the request rate up by about 80%.
Decision to roll back payments to v2.30.
Rollback complete on all payments pods.
Payments p95 back under 500 ms. Payments restored.
1,184 failed payments replayed from the retry queue.
Receipt emails for the replayed payments sent.

answer.what: receipt emails for the replayed payments sent
